open_points.unit: 30_modules.md:Facts several modules touch, and their one owner
open_points.subject: session identities in records and answers
open_points.text: “No module puts ... a session identity into ... an audit entry ... or the data of an answer” conflicts with M09 requiring “the session and the project for a grant or a revocation”, M07 recording the agent session identity, and the session-list/access answers that identify an agent session.
open_points.question: Does the prohibition mean only the owner-session identity, or does it also prohibit agent-session identities despite the audit and access models requiring them?
options: Only an OwnerSession identity is prohibited; agent-session identities may appear where M06, M07 and M09 require them.
Every session identity is prohibited, so the audit subjects and agent-session answers must omit or replace the agent-session identity.
open_points.default_guess: Treat “session identity” in the prohibition as the OwnerSession identity only, because the following sentence says it travels only in its cookie.

witness.initial: Agent session S is registered, and project P is active.
events: The owner grants project P to session S.
Registry writes the required audit entry.
The owner reads the audit log.
outcomes: The entry names S and P as M09 requires.
The entry omits or replaces S because the shared-facts prohibition forbids any session identity in an audit entry.
witness.observer: The owner reading the audit log.
